items.summary: Product recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. The highest-leverage deferred opportunities are (1) close the execution/measurement loop, (2) add failure deduplication and repair-or-close controls, (3) improve task-role routing and capability parity, (4) expose fleet-wide operational readiness in one control-plane view, (5) add AI-cost visibility to prioritization, and (6) standardize reversible, evidence-gated site improvements. Current evidence does not support new queue work: 187 approved proposals lack execution requests, 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 32 deployed improvements await measurement, only 1 outcome is proven, operations/fleet-doctor results are unavailable, and financial attribution remains incomplete. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Keep all new proposals, telemetry, experiments, dependencies, spend, requeues, deployments, and public launch changes deferred until existing gates clear.
